note: TR "panta" (all things) against "pantes" (all of you; Sinaiticus, B, P). The early text rejects an elite with special knowledge, rather than claiming omniscience.

kjv: [[but] he that acknowledgeth the Son hath the Father also]
mine: Whoever confesses the Son has the Father also
note: The KJV prints the second half in italics, as doubtful, because it was missing from the Byzantine manuscripts behind the TR; it is in fact well attested (Sinaiticus, A, B, C). A rare case where the KJV marks as uncertain what the critical text includes.
